title: Built through curiosity. Driven by engineering.
sub: Six years of building production software, owning products end to end, and solving complex engineering challenges.
paragraphs: I'm a Senior Full-Stack Software Engineer and former Founding Engineer & Tech Lead with over 6 years of experience architecting and building production systems across multiple domains, including Fintech, HR-Tech, and Marketplace platforms, spanning early-stage startups to large enterprises. Throughout my career, I've taken products from early concepts to production, worked across different stages of the product lifecycle, and contributed to engineering teams in both hands-on and technical leadership capacities.

My technical experience spans the full stack, from backend architecture, API design, and distributed systems to complex frontend applications and real-time interfaces. I work primarily with the JavaScript and TypeScript ecosystems, alongside relational and NoSQL databases, cloud infrastructure, and modern web technologies. I value understanding the system as a whole and choosing the right tools for the problem.

I began my career working independently, building applications and collaborating with clients across 20+ countries. Working across different products and industries early on gave me broad exposure to software development, from translating requirements into technical solutions to delivering complete, production-ready applications. It also taught me to adapt quickly, work autonomously, and take responsibility for the things I build.

Over time, my work evolved from independent product development to technical leadership and enterprise engineering. As a Founding Engineer & Tech Lead, I led a team of three and owned much of the architecture and development of a two-sided marketplace. Later, I worked on core backend services for a global HR-tech platform, alongside financial infrastructure and systems with demanding performance and reliability requirements.

I'm interested in understanding software beyond its abstractions. I enjoy investigating how systems behave internally, identifying performance bottlenecks, and understanding the trade-offs behind architectural decisions. Rather than treating tools and frameworks as black boxes, I prefer to understand their foundations, limitations, and interactions. That perspective shapes how I approach unfamiliar problems and build systems that are easier to reason about, maintain, and improve.
